result.result:

**Simulator calls:** I used 4 of the 10.

| Call | Weights | Dev TTS (veh-h) |

| 2 | `b3[1] -= 1` | 44.6 |

I delivered the call 3 weights. The differences between calls are about the size of seed noise (roughly 0.3), so the real effect is probably near zero.
